about: Regression floors for `pnpm eval --check-floors` (M6 D4). CI runs the mock provider, which is deterministic, so each mock floor is the measured value rounded down to two decimals: a pipeline change that lowers any of them fails the build. Mock numbers check the plumbing, not AI quality. If a change is meant to move a number (a new dataset item, a better mock), rerun `pnpm eval`, check why it moved, and update the floor in the same commit with the reason in the message. Values are point estimates in 0..1; `min` = at least, `max` = at most.
